before_times: for you, your child, or someone you help (a care home resident)
which visit: the office's own visit types only (a new patient consult, a tooth removal, a stitch check, a night guard, or a post-surgery problem), never a symptom typed into the AI
a dental or medical plan (its name only) or paying yourself
after_time: anything the office should know to help, like a wheelchair or needing an interpreter
for a care home visit: the place's name, the room, and who meets the surgeon
secure_page_only: plan member ID, the plan holder and a photo of the plan card
health history: medicines, blood thinners, allergies, conditions, and past surgery
a parent's or guardian's consent for anyone under 18, or the consent of the person who decides for an adult who can't
intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, reasons or results are never asked or typed in the AI chat
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; the care home's staff for a resident, with the decider's consent on the secure page; a minor alone only where the state's rules let minors consent to dental surgery (a switch)

stop.words: face or jaw swelling with a fever, or trouble breathing or swallowing
stop.say: This needs care now. Go to the nearest emergency room or call 911. Don't wait for a surgery visit.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words are repeated if a same-day request is declined

stop.words: bleeding after a tooth removal that won't stop, or a tooth knocked out
stop.say: Bite hard on clean gauze or a damp tea bag for 20 minutes. If it won't stop, go to the emergency room or call 911. For a knocked-out tooth, call the office's own line now.
stop.booking: no booking by the AI; the office's own line

stop.words: swallowed something poisonous, or too much of a medicine
stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222, or 911 if they're not awake or not breathing.

go_on.words: a sore or swollen spot after a removal, with nothing else
go_on.what: matched to the office's own post-surgery visit; Rosie never judges how urgent it is

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, consent and the plan's papers
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit (a same-day visit: before the time is held); one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; returning patients once a year, or when their health changes
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk or the door, before any work), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example office's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: A signed surgical consent
steps.when: on the secure page, before the surgery visit, with the price and the deposit shown first
steps.who: every surgery patient, and the parent or guardian for a child
steps.result: not signed by the surgery visit: the visit waits; Sam moves it or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The care home's OK
steps.who: the host place agrees to host the visits
steps.result: no OK: no times at that place

first_steps_and_forms.prep: eat and drink as the surgeon's sheet says; arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID, the plan card and the medicine list; a surgery visit needs an adult to take you home; at a care home: the resident's medicine list ready with the nurse

staff.skills: oral surgeons: extractions, surgical consults, night guards and post-surgery care; surgical assistants: X-rays, scans, chair setup, recovery checks and the work the state allows; only people cleared for mobile visits go to care homes and homes
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each oral surgeon's own license, per state; a surgical assistant's own license only where the state licenses assistants
staff.supervision: an assistant works only while the surgeon is in the office or on the portable visit, as the state's rules allow (a switch: some states let assistants work alone at schools and care homes)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs same-day post-surgery times, quotes over $500, and anything an assistant flags
staff.stand_in: an assistant out: the surgeon does the recovery check, or new times; the surgeon out: another oral surgeon takes the visit, or new times with no fee

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; the care home's staff for a resident, with the decider's consent on the secure page; a minor alone only where the state's rules let minors consent to dental surgery (a switch)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian; a minor who may consent alone gets texts only on their own phone, with no visit type
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)

visit.check_in: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk; at a care home or school: the code from the patient, or from the nurse or staff member named on the booking
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the surgeon's notes, X-rays and scans stay in the office's own records, never in Rosie or a text
visit.changes_at_visit: an extra tooth or a second step is priced and OK'd before it's done; the plan's estimate is shown first; a new step is booked as its own visit only with the patient's yes
visit.before_work: the assistant takes the X-rays and reads the health history first; the surgeon checks for changes before any work

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: each oral surgeon holds their own license from the state's dental board; a surgical assistant holds one only where the state licenses assistants
license.who: each person; the practice too where the state's form registers dental or surgical offices or their owners
license.ask: each person's license number in their invite reply, or the owner sends it; the practice's registration and any mobile permit number come from the owner. The owner may leave a number out
license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form asks for it; the owner states it, and Rosie does not check it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, the results, the medicines or the surgeon's name (when the surgeon comes to a care home or home, the name stays, for the door check); X-rays and scans never go through Rosie
